_notes.import: Paste or load via Import JSON Storyboard. Code fences and leading prose are stripped. A bare array of scenes, a storyboard object, or a -project.json bundle are all accepted.
_notes.required: scenes (non-empty array). Everything else has defaults.
_notes.duration: Seconds per scene, 3-600. Out-of-range values are clamped. Alias: seconds.
_notes.onscreenText: Aliases: onScreenText, caption. Defaults to the scene title.
_notes.visual: Object {type, action, props?} or a bare type string. Unknown types fall back to 'idea'.
_notes.aspectRatio: Always forced to 16:9. Shorts/vertical input is ignored with a warning.
_notes.id/index: Reassigned on import from scene order.
